Claude Code hooks are user-defined shell commands that run at fixed points in the session lifecycle. They're configured in `~/.claude/settings.json` (user) or `.claude/settings.json` (project). Common uses include auto-formatting after edits, blocking risky commands, and notifications. Hooks are deterministic, so they run every time rather than depending on the model to choose to run them. A non-zero exit lets Claude see the failure and adjust. Hook events include PreToolUse and PostToolUse. You can also manage them with `/hooks` in a session.
